d:
Hathiyar Babbal Rai’s hit is back with a fresh new look! Babbal Rai sings, Desi Routz made the music and Veet Baljit wrote the lyrics. The song was originally released as “Kareena Wargi” and is now presented under its new name, Hathiyar.
Song Credits
Song - Kareena Wargi
Singer - Babbal Rai
Music - Desi Routz
Lyrics - Veet Baljit
Label - Speed Records
